# John & Co. Heritage Farms & Landholdings LLC

> Veteran-led South Carolina limited liability company formed in South Carolina in October 2026. Developing agricultural sourcing and distribution, production partnerships, and property and forestry services. These lines of work are PLANNED and not yet operating.

Documented: formed in South Carolina in October 2026; founded and led by Alex Dalton (Johnathan Alexander Dalton), a U.S. Marine Corps veteran.
Not claimed: No claim is made of an active SAM.gov registration, CAGE code, SBA VetCert or SDVOSB certification, awarded contracts, customers, past performance, land ownership or control, owned production assets, or currently available supply.
Contact: daltonalex59@gmail.com · 864-933-9965.
